title: Hokum
review: Adam Scott seems distractingly out of place here, and I guess that's the point. He's meant to be a big American personality in a quiet rural community where he just can't fit in. It's my least favourite of his feature length films so far, but I'm still always going to look forward Damian McCarthy's work. There were some good twists, but the story just wasn't as mysterious as {Caveat} or {Oddity}, and so it didn't combine a sense of dread with the fear of the unknown, like they did.
